// PKGPATH: gno.land/r/test/katanafixtures/frac/z_frac_filetest

package z_frac_filetest

import (
	"chain/runtime/unsafe"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/r/gov/dao"
	daov3init "gno.land/r/gov/dao/v3/init"
)

var (
	c     address = unsafe.OriginCaller()
	alice         = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob           = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
)

func init(cur realm) {
	testing.SetHeight(123)
	daov3init.InitWithUsers(cross(cur), c, alice, bob)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(c)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(c))
	ex := dao.NewSimpleExecutor(0, cur, func(realm) error { return nil }, "")
	dao.MustCreateProposal(cross(cur), dao.NewProposalRequest("Eject validator onbloc", "Validator onbloc health score 12 < 30.", ex))
	ex2 := dao.NewSimpleExecutor(0, cur, func(realm) error { return nil }, "")
	dao.MustCreateProposal(cross(cur), dao.NewProposalRequest("Eject validator teritori", "Validator teritori health score 8 < 30.", ex2))
}

func vote(cur realm, who address, opt dao.VoteOption, pid int64) {
	testing.SetOriginCaller(who)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(who))
	dao.MustVoteOnProposal(cross(cur), dao.NewVoteRequest(opt, dao.ProposalID(pid)))
}

func main(cur realm) {
	vote(cur, c, dao.YesVote, 0)
	vote(cur, alice, dao.YesVote, 0)
	vote(cur, c, dao.YesVote, 1)
	vote(cur, alice, dao.NoVote, 1)
	vote(cur, bob, dao.AbstainVote, 1)
	println("=== open_two_thirds_yes (0)")
	println(dao.Render(cross(cur), "0"))
	println("=== open_split (1)")
	println(dao.Render(cross(cur), "1"))
}
